bootsoff: A man sits on the edge of a low bed with his feet on the floor. He leans forward, lifts his right foot onto his left knee, grips the heel of his boot with both hands and pulls the boot off, sets it down on the floor, then does the same with the left foot, and sits back up relaxed.
vestoff: A man sits on the edge of a bed. He shrugs a vest off his shoulders with both hands, pulls his arms out of it one at a time, folds it once and lays it down beside him on the bed.
bootson: A man sits on the edge of a bed, leans forward, picks a boot up from the floor, pulls it onto his right foot with both hands and stamps it down, then pulls the other boot onto his left foot, and sits up.
veston: A man sits on the edge of a bed, picks up a vest lying beside him, puts one arm in, then the other, and pulls it straight over his shoulders with both hands.
sitrub: A tired man sits on the edge of a bed, rubs his face with both hands, yawns and stretches his neck, his hands then rest on his knees.
